articles.summary: U.S. Bureau of Land Management certifies acceptance of the company’s Tonopah Flats Lithium Project mine and refinery Plan of Operations, advancing permitting for one of the nation’s largest known lithium resources and a globally significant project supporting domestic critical mineral production and energy security Reno, Nev. – September 8, 2026 – American Battery Technology Company…
articles.title: American Battery Technology Company Achieves Major Milestone with U.S. BLM Acceptance of Plan of Operations for Tonopah Flats Lithium Project
